item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description:
## What's new
- **Password and users.** **Server Settings** has a password for the default user and a **Users** list for extra accounts, each with its own password and full or read-only access. Passwords are kept in your Keychain, not in the saved server list, and are handed to the server privately rather than on its command line. - **Copy URL.** Copies `valkey://127.0.0.1:PORT` (with the password when one is set) from the server's window or its menu-bar menu. With extra users it offers one entry per user. - **Max memory and eviction policy.** Set a memory limit and what the server does when it's full. - **Save data to disk.** Turn it off for a cache-only server with no data files. - **Live stats.** A running server's window shows memory, operations per second, clients, keys and hit rate, with graphs of the last few minutes. - **Crash recovery.** A server that exits unexpectedly is restarted automatically and you get a notification. If it keeps failing (3 times in a minute) it's left stopped. Turn this off per server in **Server Settings**. - **Log filter.** Type in the **Filter** box above a server's log to show only matching lines. - **Edit valkey.conf.** The **Files** menu opens a server's config in your text editor. **Start** becomes **Restart** while the server runs, to apply changes. - **valkey-cli on your PATH.** **Settings → Command Line** links `valkey-cli` to the newest installed version and shows the line to add to your shell profile.

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
## What's new
- **Send feedback or report a bug by email.** **Send Feedback…** and **Report a Bug…** are in the Help menu and the menu-bar menu. Each opens a draft email you can read and edit before sending. A bug report includes your app, macOS and Valkey versions and each server's state and recent log lines, but no file paths. - **Report errors in one click.** Error messages (a server that won't start, a failed install or download) now have a **Report a Bug…** link that puts the error text into the email.
## Fixes
- **A damaged saved server list no longer wipes your servers.** If Valkey.app can't read its saved list, it now keeps a copy instead of overwriting it with an empty one on the next change. - **Clearer errors when a server can't start.** If the data directory or its default config can't be created, or **Connect…** can't write its script, Valkey.app now says why instead of failing silently. - **A bad `registryURL` setting no longer crashes the app.** It falls back to the default registry.

item.title: Version 1.4
item.description:
## What's new
- **Modules.** Add official Valkey modules to any server: **JSON** (JSON documents with JSONPath queries) and **Bloom** (Bloom filters). Open **Server Settings → Modules → Add Module…**, search the catalog, and add what you need. Modules download when you save. - Each module build is tested against every Valkey version it's offered for, so you only see modules that work with your server's version. - A server with a module turned on won't start without it, because data saved with a module can't be loaded without that module. Removing a module from a server shows a warning. - **Versions…** lists installed module builds, with Install and Remove.
## Fixes
- **Logging out or restarting no longer gets blocked.** Quitting from the Dock, logout, restart and scripts now always quit Valkey.app and stop your servers gracefully. Before, with no Valkey window open, those quits could be cancelled. ⌘Q still closes Valkey to the menu bar while the menu-bar icon is shown.

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
## Fixes
- **Settings… in the menu-bar menu now opens Settings when no Valkey window is open.** Before, it opened the Settings window behind your other apps, so it looked like nothing happened. **Open Valkey…** now brings Valkey forward the same way.

item.title: Version 1.3
item.description:
## What's new
- **Quit Completely** in the Valkey menu. While the menu-bar icon is shown, ⌘Q closes Valkey to the menu bar and keeps your servers running. Quit Completely really quits and stops your servers. With the menu-bar icon turned off, ⌘Q already quits, so the item is hidden.
## Fixes
- The menu-bar menu no longer shows ⌘Q next to **Quit Valkey.app** or ⌘, next to **Settings…**. Those shortcuts don't do what the hint suggested: ⌘Q only closes to the menu bar. ⌘, still opens Settings from the Valkey menu.

item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
## What's new
- **Automatic updates.** Valkey.app now checks for updates. When one is available, it shows the release notes and asks before downloading. Once you confirm, it installs the update and relaunches, and servers that were running start again. Check any time with **Check for Updates…** in the app menu, the menu-bar menu or Settings, and turn automatic checks on or off in **Settings → Updates**. - **⌘Q keeps Valkey running** in the menu bar while the menu-bar icon is shown, so your servers stay up. To really quit, use **Quit** in the menu-bar menu or the Dock icon's menu. With the menu-bar icon turned off, ⌘Q quits. - **Ghostty without the prompt.** Connect… now opens `valkey-cli` through Ghostty's AppleScript support (Ghostty 1.3 or later), so Ghostty no longer asks "Allow?" every time. macOS asks once for permission to control Ghostty.
